name: Ferienhaus Wasserfallhütte
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Wasserfallhütte is located on the edge of Kufstein, surrounded by forest and mountain meadows. From the terrace, you have a view of the surrounding Tiroler Berglandschaft. The chalet offers a cosy open-plan kitchen and living area, three bedrooms and a tiled stove. Guests can use the hiking trails in the surrounding area or reach the town centre of Kufstein in just a few minutes. Parking spaces are available.
